title: signal.dispatched
description: PAYLOAD of the `signal.dispatched` envelope. Topic: signals.signal.dispatched. ★★ THE FLAGSHIP event (§11 revenue-truth loop, moat (1)). Emitted by the signals service after it dispatches a ground-truth outcome to a platform conversions API (Meta CAPI web/CRM/business-messaging incl CTWA; Google Enhanced Conversions for Leads + offline adjustments). value carries the lead-quality score (or true Purchase value) so the platform optimizes for revenue truth, not junk 'lead submitted' events. event_id = hash(journey_id + ladder_step) for idempotent dedup >=90% (§11.3). Canonical field shape from Appendix A.

endpoint.description: Which conversions surface (Appendix A: capi). business_messaging keys on ctwa_clid (§11.2); ec_leads + offline_adjustment = Google quality loop (§11.3).

event_name.description: The event-ladder step (§11.1): Lead | QualifiedLead | Schedule | Attended | Purchase (Appendix A: QualifiedLead). QualifiedLead/Attended are custom events.

dispatch_event_id.description: The dedup event_id = hash(journey_id + ladder_step) (Appendix A event_id: 'sha256(j_+step2)'). Makes re-sends idempotent => dedup >=90% (§11.3 invariant).

match_keys.description: Which hashed match keys were attached (Appendix A: [ph,fbc,ctwa_clid]). Max keys => higher EMQ (§11.3 target EMQ>=8). PII is SHA-256 normalized; raw PII never leaves (§5.4).

value.description: Conversion value (Appendix A: 78). On Lead = lead_score (predicted-value proxy); on Purchase = true order value. INR.

journey_ref.description: The correlation_id (journey) this signal belongs to — ties the dispatch back to the person's funnel.

source_ad_ref.description: The ad the conversion is attributed to (from ctwa_clid / fbclid / gclid), form platform:ad:id.

latency_ms.description: source(occurred_at) -> dispatched latency in ms; SLA p95 <=15min (§11.3). For AI calls, India edge target <60s.

dedup_key.description: The dedup key used against the platform (mirrors dispatch_event_id; surfaced for the Signal Health card §11.3).
